About

TAREQ IELTS Speaking Practice
Question bank sourced from Makkar IELTS Speaking Guesswork, Sep–Dec 2026 (Final Version) by Dr Kiranpreet Kaur Makkar.

All practice data is stored locally in your browser (localStorage). No account, no internet, no server required.

🎙 AI Speaking Evaluation

Record your answers, get AI-powered IELTS band scores and detailed feedback. ● Checking server...

How It Works

1. Go to any Part 1, Part 2, or Part 3 question and click 🎙 Record Answer.
2. Speak your answer — you'll see a live transcript as you talk.
3. When done, edit any transcription errors in the transcript box.
4. Come back here and click Submit My Answers for AI Evaluation below.
5. Get your estimated IELTS band scores, grammar corrections, vocabulary improvements, and pronunciation feedback.

📝 Full IELTS Speaking Mock Test

Take a complete simulated IELTS Speaking examination with automatic timers and AI evaluation.

How the Full Mock Test Works

Part 1 — Introduction & Interview (4–5 questions, 30s each)
Part 2 — Individual Long Turn (1 cue card, 1 min prep + 2 min speaking)
Part 3 — Two-way Discussion (3–5 follow-up questions, 45s each)

The system automatically selects questions from your existing database, randomizes them, and organizes them into a complete test. After finishing, get your AI-estimated IELTS band scores.

📊 Test History

View your completed mock tests, compare scores, and review past performance.

📈 Evaluation History

All your AI-evaluated speaking answers. Compare your progress, review feedback, and re-listen to recordings.
🔒 Where your data is stored: All evaluations, transcripts, and audio recordings are saved locally in your browser (localStorage + IndexedDB). Nothing is uploaded to any external server except for the brief moment when the transcript is sent to Google Gemini for evaluation. Clearing your browser data, or clicking the button below, will permanently delete everything.
